headline: Belinda Bencic and Trump Says Iran Deal Was Largely Negotiated Saturday
summary: US President Donald Trump said on Saturday that a deal with Tehran had been largely negotiated and would end the war while reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Final terms remain unsettled.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so its status drives energy prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: A deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz would ease fears of supply disruption, which can push oil prices lower.
